name: Bone-Choir
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Hymn of Clarity
abilities.description: When the bone-choir starts its turn within 5 feet of an ally, the bone-choir ends the blinded, deafened, or poisoned condition on that ally.

abilities.name: Aura of Authority
abilities.description: While in a 10-foot radius originating from the bone-choir, the bone-choir and its allies have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the bone-choir is not incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The bone-choir makes three attacks, using Slam or Dirge Lash. It can replace one attack with a use of Dirge Lure.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dirge Lash
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dirge Lure
actions.description: Each creature of the bone-choir's choice in a 90-foot radius originating from the bone-choir that can see or hear the bone-choir must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed until the end of its next turn, and while charmed this way, it must move toward the bone-choir by the safest available route on its turn and can't take Reactions. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's lure for 24 hours.
